text:
Shenendehowa High School in Saratoga County welcomed most students in 2025-26 school year
T. H. Kelly
Shenendehowa High School had the highest enrollment among Saratoga County schools, welcoming 3,014 students during the 2025-26 academic year, according to the New York State Education Department.
Data also showed that most of the students were white, representing 69.8% of Shenendehowa High School's total enrollment.
Among the 50 schools in Saratoga County, Saratoga Springs High School ranked second in enrollment numbers with 1,904 students, while Maple Avenue Middle School welcomed 1,371 students and came in third in the 2025-26 school year.
Shenendehowa High School is part of Shenendehowa Central School District, which roughly covers 12 schools within Saratoga County and has a main office in Clifton Park.
In the previous school year, Shenendehowa High School also had the highest number of students among Saratoga County schools.
New York ranks second nationwide in K-12 public education spending, with current expenditures averaging $30,012 per student, nearly double the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
